observations: Photo 0 shows two stripped-down car engine assemblies sitting on a dirt/concrete floor, surrounded by other scrap parts and wiring.
Wiring harnesses, intake manifolds, and valve covers are exposed and disconnected; no engine covers, no mounting in a vehicle, no ancillary parts like alternator/starter visible.
Text 'FORD' is legible embossed on the intake manifold of the left engine.
Text on the right engine's manifold is partially visible but not clearly legible.
No VIN plate, no engine code sticker, no compression/start-up test shown.
Background shows a cluttered scrapyard/parts shop setting with a person partially visible.

Clear photo of engine code/casting number stamped on the block
Close-up of the second engine's brand/model marking
Photos from multiple angles (oil pan, rear, wiring harness ends) in good light
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type (used Ford engine assembly, brand visible in photo 0) even without a model number, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified, non-running, parts-only unit; the second engine is excluded from pricing due to illegible branding.
